description: This file defines a React component named MultipleSelectedNotes, which manages the UI for handling multiple selected notes within a web application. It includes buttons and panels for actions like pinning notes, changing editors, and viewing note options, and is part of a larger note management system.

methods.name: MultipleSelectedNotes
methods.description: React functional component that displays interface for managing multiple note selections, including actions and status display.

methods.name: cancelMultipleSelection
methods.description: Callback to cancel the multiple note selection mode.
